title: Chronic Outage Count Threshold and Company-Controllable Causes — Electric Service Agreement Decision Table
content:
**Electric Service Agreement — chronic threshold where outages arise from causes within the company's control.**

The chronic threshold is lowered by two records when four or more outage records at the address recorded as equipment failure or vegetation began in the 12 calendar months before the posting, lowered by one record when two or three such records began in that period, and is not lowered when one or none did, because those causes lie within the company's own control.

| Outage records at the address recorded as equipment failure or vegetation, begun in the 12 calendar months before the posting | Chronic threshold |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | the schedule's chronic outage count threshold less 2 |
| 2 or 3 | the schedule's chronic outage count threshold less 1 |
| 0 or 1 | not lowered |

**Counting.** Equipment-failure records and vegetation records are counted together. The period is always the 12 calendar months before the posting; every count over a stated number of calendar months before a posting takes the records dated less than that many whole calendar months before the posting date. A record that began on the boundary day, exactly 12 whole calendar months before the posting date, is outside the count; one that began on the day after is inside it.

**Where the threshold acts.** The chronic threshold so set is the threshold in every comparison of the outage record count with the chronic threshold, including the test of whether the count has reached it.

**Hypothetical checks.** Schedule chronic outage count threshold of 6:

| Equipment-failure records | Vegetation records | Combined | Chronic threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 1 | 6 |
| 1 | 1 | 2 | 5 |
| 3 | 0 | 3 | 5 |
| 2 | 2 | 4 | 4 |
